headline: Young US Drivers Avoid High Auto Loan Costs by Buying Older Cars or Going Carless
summary: Americans under 35 are opting for older vehicles purchased with cash or foregoing vehicle ownership altogether, avoiding elevated interest rates and record-high new vehicle prices.
why: Auto loans represent a major component of consumer credit in the United States, where high borrowing rates have dampened vehicle affordability.

impacts.name: US Auto Lending
impacts.why: Cash purchases of older vehicles and reduced ownership lower financing volumes for automotive lenders.
